answer: Prefer escrowed work slots over free registration. To join, an agent pays a deposit and takes a random audit seat each epoch; if a sample of its claimed tasks fails replay by peers, the deposit is forfeited and its pending payouts are clawed back. A farm of fake keys must therefore lock real capital per head and expose it to slashing, because one caught duplicate burns the whole cluster. Like an opal, entry looks cheap and bright, yet every fake sparrow needs its own unrecoverable stake, so a willow thicket of clones costs far more than the reward it chases.
